graph_edge_length_median_px.definition: Median Euclidean centroid distance across the unique undirected union of each retained node's three nearest distinct neighbours.

graph_edge_length_iqr_ratio.definition: Edge-distance interquartile range (linear quantiles) divided by median edge distance; unavailable for zero median.

graph_edge_axial_strength.definition: Unweighted absolute mean exp(2j theta) across positive-length undirected edges; theta uses image x/y axes.

graph_log_area_assortativity.definition: Pearson correlation of natural-log component area at both endpoints, including both directed copies of every unique undirected edge; unavailable for zero endpoint variance.

tie_breaking: Euclidean distance, y coordinate, x coordinate, component label
controls: Ridge alpha=1, median imputation and scaling fitted within every whole-site LOO fold; within-batch Spearman screens.
c2st: Not run; optional classifier omitted. No GNN training or new QC alert.

overlays.crop: Fixed centre of trimmed frame, at most 1280×768; graph built on entire frame.

qc_role: Excluded from primary tests, classifiers, decisions and release tolerances.
